title: Verb mieć — to have
grammarPoint: Present tense of mieć: mam, masz, ma, mamy, macie, mają
grammarPoint_fa: زمان حال فعل mieć: mam، masz، ma، mamy، macie، mają

explanation.text:
The verb **mieć** (to have) is one of the most common Polish verbs. It follows a regular conjugation pattern in the present tense.

| Person | Polish | English |
|--------|--------|---------|
| ja | **mam** | I have |
| ty | **masz** | you have |
| on/ona/ono | **ma** | he/she/it has |
| my | **mamy** | we have |
| wy | **macie** | you (all) have |
| oni/one | **mają** | they have |

After mieć, the possessed noun goes in the **accusative case** (covered in Ch.4). For now practise with words that don't change much.
notes: mam = I have (most frequent form — learn it first)
Negation: nie mam = I don't have
Mieć is also used in age: Mam 25 lat = I am 25 years old.

explanation_fa: فعل mieć (داشتن) یکی از پرکاربردترین افعال لهستانی است. اشکال: mam (دارم)، masz (داری)، ma (دارد)، mamy (داریم)، macie (دارید)، mają (دارند). برای بیان مالکیت و روابط خانوادگی استفاده می‌شود: Mam brata (برادر دارم).

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct form: Ona ___ kota.
exercises.explanation: Third person singular (ona = she) uses ma. 'Ona ma kota' = She has a cat.

exercises.prompt: ___ brata i siostrę. (I have a brother and a sister.)

exercises.explanation: You heard: 'Mamy dużo czasu.' — We have a lot of time. First person plural mamy.
'Mają psa' = They have a dog. 'Oni' is optional. 'Psa' is the accusative of 'pies'.

exercises.prompt: How do you say 'I don't have a car' in Polish?
exercises.explanation: 'Nie mam' = I don't have. Negation places 'nie' directly before the verb. Note 'samochodu' is genitive after negation.
